organization.basis: Primary contribution, not mutually exclusive algorithm classes. Complete representation, preparation and runtime costs are shared comparison conditions.

changes: Three canonical challenges and seven classified landscape cards, with an explicit technical thesis and shared comparison basis in both languages.
Challenge links target their own original research-card IDs; groups link back to their corresponding challenge, including background/mechanism partial views.
Nine academic paper cases collapsed by default; one active case at a time. Complete evidence remains mounted, with existing citations, saved-reading IDs and legacy route anchors.
Removed the redundant visible research-scope card; retained old scope anchors and related W/A and KV Cache links. Removed the unrendered scope card from the search index.
Landscape headings use group h4, approach h5 and explanation h6; shared cost accounting is outside the three-group map.

browser_qa.desktop: Three groups contain 3/3/1 cards; all nine paper cases initially closed; no visible scope heading; AWQ click opens its full evidence.
browser_qa.navigation: Clicked quality challenge to calibration, then group back to quality challenge. Also clicked the same path in partial background/mechanism views; view and visible target matched.
browser_qa.mobile: 390 x 844: one-column challenge grid, no whole-page horizontal overflow, quality target top 179.98 px after sticky-header offset repair.
browser_qa.earlier_case_walkthrough: AWQ to GPTQ closes AWQ; Enter closes selected case. AWQ citation and return reopen the correct case; narrow-screen case title remains visible.

limits: Editorial regrouping of existing cited content; no new scientific result or independent reproduction is claimed. Publication receipt supplies exact pushed source, archive and deployment identities.
